about: Known-good speed and memory (root CLAUDE.md, Metrics and baselines), checked on every pull request by .github/scripts/baseline.py (ci.yml, job baseline). Metric names are <kernel|app>.<operation>.<kind>; the kind picks the margin. Update the values only when the owner confirms a change is intended: python3 .github/scripts/baseline.py --update. Values are from GitHub's ubuntu-latest runners. The same file holds the magic-moment journeys (journeys_about, journeys).
journeys_about: Magic-moment journeys (X8, packages/testing/src/magic.ts): the most clicks and the slowest of 5 walks in Chromium on GitHub's ubuntu-latest runners, confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-16. apps/fission/e2e/journeys.mjs fails on any extra click (every run) and, nightly (JOURNEY_NIGHTLY=1), on a slowest walk more than 15% over.

instructions.why: callgrind's count of instructions executed: the same on every run to about 0.05%, so any real slowdown shows; 15% is the project's performance margin

peak_bytes.why: most extra heap at once, from a counting allocator: exact, so 15% catches real growth

retained_bytes.why: JavaScript heap a result keeps after a full GC; the floor absorbs the engine's own few kilobytes of noise

wasm_bytes.why: the kernel's WebAssembly memory high-water mark, in 64 KiB pages; one page of slack

relative_time.why: time divided by a fixed JavaScript workload's in the same process; still varies by about 15% between runs and machines, so past 15% it only warns, and only twice as slow fails
